evidence: Source review against native build 1: this change lets the server admit a version 2 Node release. It adds a closed version 2 runtime contract, binds deploy.yml to version 1 and publish-typescript-release.yml to version 2 in update discovery, requires an exact Alembic frontier for version 2 at staging and before the service stops, and adds a trusted host-Node admission probe. Files changed: environments/app.py, runtime_admission.py, runtime_contracts.py, update_install.py, update_provider.py, update_service.py. The only native-facing update surface, /api/deployment-status (state, deployedSha, targetSha, outcome, detail, validUntil, successDisplayUntil from logic/update_experience.py), is unchanged; new refusal reasons can appear only as text in the existing detail string. A search of ios/ for runtime_contract, python_version, node_major, minimum_node, schema_floor and /api/update finds no use. Routes, payload shapes, event kinds, status codes and the build floor are unchanged. Verification: full unit suite 1913 passed, 7 skipped; integration 151 passed, 13 skipped; ruff and mypy clean. No signed-device, TestFlight, or native reconnect checks ran.
